title: Smart112Dispatch
description: Contract schema for authoritative emergency unit dispatch execution and tracking.

dispatch_id.description: Unique UUID for this dispatch transaction.

incident_id.description: UUID of the incident to which the unit is assigned.

unit_id.description: Authoritative identifier of the dispatched response unit.

dispatcher_id.description: Identifier of the authenticated human dispatcher authorizing deployment.

status.description: Current real-time operational status of the assignment.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of dispatch issuance.
